question: For support tickets opened in 2025 that have been resolved, what was the median number of days to resolve a ticket in each region?

sql_attempts.sql: WITH resolved_2025 AS (SELECT r.region_name, (JULIANDAY(t.resolved_date) - JULIANDAY(t.created_date)) AS resolution_days FROM support_tickets AS t JOIN customers AS c ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN regions AS r ON c.region_id = r.region_id WHERE t.created_date >= '2025-01-01' AND t.created_date <= '2025-12-31' AND NOT t.resolved_date IS NULL), ranked AS (SELECT region_name, resolution_days, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY region_name ORDER BY resolution_days ASC, ticket_id ASC) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY region_name) AS cnt FROM (SELECT r.region_name, t.resolved_date, t.created_date, t.ticket_id, (JULIANDAY(t.resolved_date) - JULIANDAY(t.created_date)) AS resolution_days FROM support_tickets AS t JOIN customers AS c ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN regions AS r ON c.region_id = r.region_id WHERE t.created_date >= '2025-01-01' AND t.created_date <= '2025-12-31' AND NOT t.resolved_date IS NULL)) SELECT region_name, AVG(resolution_days) AS median_resolution_days FROM ranked WHERE rn IN ((cnt + 1) / 2, (cnt + 2) / 2) GROUP BY region_name LIMIT 500
